### Isabella Bank Corporation Announces Completion of Merger with Grand River Commerce, Inc. and the Results of Merger Consideration Elections


November 2, 2026


**MOUNT PLEASANT, MI /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 2, 2026 /** Isabella Bank Corporation (the "Company" or "Isabella") (NASDAQ:ISBA), the parent company of Isabella Bank, announced today the completion of the previously announced acquisition of Grand River Commerce, Inc., the parent company of Grand River Bank (collectively "Grand River"), effective November 2, 2026.


The combined company has approximately $2.7 billion in total assets, $2.0 billion in loans, and $2.3 billion in total deposits (based on financial information as of June 30, 2026). This strategic acquisition extends Isabella Bank's footprint into Kent County and the vibrant Grand Rapids market, including bringing Isabella Wealth Services to these new markets.


"This strategic partnership will accelerate our growth in this vibrant Grand Rapids market," said Jerome E. Schwind, president and chief executive officer of Isabella Bank Corporation, "and harnesses the strengths of two community banks dedicated to relationship-based banking and community engagement. We are thrilled to welcome our new customers and team to Isabella Bank and look forward to working together to provide expanded products, services, and resources."


Additionally, the Company announced today the results of the elections regarding the merger consideration to be received by stockholders of Grand River in the Company's acquisition of Grand River.


Grand River stockholders were entitled to elect to receive either (x) $5.71 in cash or (y) 0.1413 shares of Isabella common stock for each share of Grand River common stock and will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares based on a price of $38.90 per share.


Based on the election results and applying the provisions set forth in the merger agreement, whereby 35% of the outstanding shares of Grand River common stock will be exchanged for cash and 65% of the outstanding shares of Grand River common stock will be exchanged for Isabella common stock:


- Grand River stockholders will receive 0.1413 shares of Isabella common stock for each share of Grand River common stock for which they made a valid stock election;
- Grand River stockholders who expressed no preference or did not make a valid election will receive 0.1413 shares of Isabella common stock for each share of Grand River common stock they hold; and
- Grand River stockholders who made a valid cash election will receive, (i) in exchange for approximately 41.280815% of the shares of Grand River common stock held by such persons, cash at the rate of $5.71 for each Grand River share so exchanged, and (ii) for the balance of the Grand River shares held by such persons, Isabella common stock at the rate of 0.1413 shares of Isabella common stock for each Grand River share so exchanged.


Of the 9,136,529 shares of Grand River common stock outstanding as of the record date for the election process:


- Holders of 3,690,634 shares, or 40.39%, elected to receive Isabella common stock, did not make a valid election or did not express a preference; and
- Holders of 5,445,895 shares, or 59.61%, elected to receive cash.


Piper Sandler & Co. acted as financial advisor to Isabella, and Luse Gorman, PC acted as its legal advisor in the Transaction. Brean Capital, LLC acted as financial advisor to Grand River, and Hunton Andrews Kurth LLP acted as its legal advisor in the Transaction.


**About Isabella Bank Corporation**


Isabella is the parent holding company of Isabella Bank, a Michigan state-chartered community bank headquartered in Mt Pleasant, Michigan. Isabella Bank was established in 1903 and has been committed to serving its customers' and communities' local banking needs for over 120 years. Isabella Bank offers personal and commercial lending and deposit products, as well as investment, trust and estate planning services. Isabella Bank has 33 locations throughout nine Michigan counties: Bay, Clare, Gratiot, Isabella, Kent, Mecosta, Midland, Montcalm and Saginaw.


For more information about Isabella Bank Corporation, visit the Investor Relations link at[www.isabellabank.com](https://pr.report/t14w) .
